{{Enemy Echo Tabs}} {{Enemy Infobox |name = The False Sovereign |title = |image = The False Sovereign Icon.png |dmgtype = Electro |dmgtype2 = Havoc |weakpoint = Unknown |echo = Yes |class = Overlord |family = Tacet Discord |group = Dark Tide Creation |nation = Rinascita |region = Sanguis Plateaus |subregion = Earthrend Wedge |drops = Blighted Crown of Puppet King |variants = Tactical Hologram: The False Sovereign }} {{Lang|'''The False Sovereign'''|zh=伪作的神王}} is an [[Overlord Class]] [[Boss]] in ''[[Wuthering Waves]]'' that can be found in {{Location|Earthrend Wedge}}, and is unlocked after completing {{Quest|By Sun's Burning Hand}}. ==Drops== {{Boss Rewards|regular=1|exclusive=Blighted Crown of Puppet King}} ==Stats== {{Enemy Stats}} ==Abilities== ==Trophies== {{Trophies|The False Sovereign}} ==Description== {{Description|This enemy has {{Color|help|higher RES}} against {{Color|Electro DMG}} and {{Color|Havoc DMG}}.

A humanoid mimic molded of sludge, a false sovereign, the [[Dark Tide]]'s will made manifest.

Born from the utopia of Unity envisioned by the Threnodian, it is a shapeless mass of black sludge given form, a vessel created solely to devour. All things are to unite within the False Sovereign's body and be reborn as servants and children of [[Leviathan]].

It does not think. It does not feel. Only the rippling sludge murmurs its false hymns, eternally glorifying the power of Leviathan.|Description When Discovered}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = The False Sovereign |zhs = 伪作的神王 |zht = 偽作的神王 |ja = 偽りの神王 |ko = 거짓의 신왕 |es = Falso Soberano |fr = Souverain apocryphe |de = Falscher Gebieter }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.6}} ==Navigation== {{Enemy Navbox}}
